# FXNewsBias

> Free real-time forex news sentiment dashboard. AI-powered bias analysis for the 8 major currencies and 15 most-traded pairs, refreshed every 3 hours.

FXNewsBias scans hundreds of forex news sources every 3 hours and uses Claude AI to score each currency and pair as Bullish, Bearish or Neutral. The site is free, requires no account to view sentiment, and is built for retail forex traders who want a fast read on market bias before placing trades.

## Core pages

- [Home / Live Dashboard](https://fxnewsbias.com/): live sentiment scores for all 8 majors
- [All Currencies](https://fxnewsbias.com/currencies): currency strength meter and bias for USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, AUD, CAD, CHF, NZD
- [All Pairs](https://fxnewsbias.com/pairs): bias matrix for the 15 most-traded forex pairs
- [News Feed](https://fxnewsbias.com/news): latest forex news with sentiment tags
- [Daily Insights](https://fxnewsbias.com/insight/): session wraps for Asia, London, New York
- [Economic Calendar](https://fxnewsbias.com/calendar): upcoming high-impact data
- [Community](https://fxnewsbias.com/community): trader discussion

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://fxnewsbias.com/pricing): Free forever for live bias, pair reads, news and the calendar. Pro adds sentiment history, bias flip alerts, the weekly brief and the developer API, at $30 a month, $75 for 3 months ($25/mo) or $240 a year ($20/mo). Same features on every period. One 7-day free trial per account.

## Transparency

- [Data quality](https://fxnewsbias.com/data-quality): live coverage report for the sentiment series, published straight from the database. Row counts, first and last reading, complete days, any short days, and scorecard settlement counts. Machine-readable at https://fxnewsbias.com/data-quality.json with no key required.

## Developer API

- [Forex Sentiment API](https://fxnewsbias.com/developers): REST API returning news sentiment scores for the 8 major currencies as JSON, refreshed every 3 hours, plus a session pair bias scorecard. Bearer token auth, 200 requests per day, included with FXNewsBias Pro at $30/month with a 7 day free trial. Forward data only, no historical series.

## Legal and policies

- [Terms of Service](https://fxnewsbias.com/terms): subscription plans, the one free trial per account rule, Developer API terms including attribution and redistribution limits, refunds, governing law.
- [Privacy Policy](https://fxnewsbias.com/privacy): what is collected, the vendors used, cookie and retention detail.
- [Risk Disclaimer](https://fxnewsbias.com/disclaimer): sentiment scores are descriptive news tone, not trading advice or signals. Applies to API data too.
